lines.zh: 我踩过麦田，麦子自己倒下。
lines.en: I walk through the wheat and it falls by itself.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很慢，田垄替我算着路。
lines.en: My steps are slow; the furrows count the way for me.

lines.zh: 我一路走，一路把作物嚼进喉咙。
lines.en: I chew crops down my throat as I go.

lines.zh: 干草块在我嘴里碎成甜渣。
lines.en: Hay bales crumble into sweet grit in my mouth.

lines.zh: 树苗还没长高，就进了我肚子。
lines.en: Saplings enter my belly before they grow tall.

lines.zh: 我走过菜地，只留下断茎。
lines.en: I cross the garden and leave only broken stems.

lines.zh: 八层甲片随步子互相摩擦。
lines.en: Eight layers of plating scrape together as I move.

lines.zh: 我不绕路，篱笆挡不住我。
lines.en: I take no detour; fences do not stop me.

lines.zh: 每一步都在攒下一口饥饿点。
lines.en: Every step stores another point of hunger.

lines.zh: 我拖着长臂，把南瓜藤扫开。
lines.en: I drag my long arms and sweep the pumpkin vines aside.

lines.zh: 泥土在我脚下变得又干又白。
lines.en: The soil turns dry and pale beneath my feet.

lines.zh: 我朝有庄稼的方向走，从不回头。
lines.en: I walk toward crops and never look back.

lines.zh: 我站着，喉咙里在数饥饿点。
lines.en: I stand still, counting hunger points in my throat.

lines.zh: 肚子空了，我就想起那片麦田。
lines.en: When my belly empties, I remember that wheat field.

lines.zh: 五秒一到，我喉头便亮一下。
lines.en: Every five seconds my throat glints once.

lines.zh: 菌丝从甲片缝里慢慢探头。
lines.en: Mycelium slowly pokes out between my plates.

lines.zh: 我不呼吸，只等下一口作物。
lines.en: I do not breathe; I wait for the next mouthful of crops.

lines.zh: 村里人曾和我同住，现在不同了。
lines.en: Villagers once shared a roof with me, no longer.

lines.zh: 我记得镰刀的声音，但不再怕。
lines.en: I remember the sound of sickles, and no longer fear it.

lines.zh: 太阳照着我的甲，晒不热里面。
lines.en: The sun warms my plating, never what is inside.

lines.zh: 我在等一块刚种下的田。
lines.en: I am waiting for a field that was just sown.

lines.zh: 饥饿点满了，我却不急着吐。
lines.en: My hunger points are full, but I do not hurry to spit.

lines.zh: 我的影子比身体更长。
lines.en: My shadow stretches longer than my body.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有村民在关门。
lines.en: I hear a villager shutting a door far off.

lines.zh: 喉咙里数着，还差几口作物。
lines.en: My throat counts the crops I still need to eat.

lines.zh: 风把腐味吹回我自己脸上。
lines.en: The wind blows my own rot back into my face.

lines.zh: 我在记哪块地刚翻过土
lines.en: I note which field was just tilled.

lines.zh: 喉咙里的酸味慢慢积起来
lines.en: The sour taste builds slowly in my throat.

lines.zh: 有一根菌丝碰到了我的牙
lines.en: A hypha brushes against my teeth.

lines.zh: 我记得这片田以前是谁的
lines.en: I remember whose field this used to be.

lines.zh: 我抬眼，先看你身后的田。
lines.en: I look up, and check the field behind you first.

lines.zh: 你的背包里，有没有种子？
lines.en: Is there seed in that pack of yours?

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，像盯一株庄稼。
lines.en: I stare at your hands the way I stare at crops.

lines.zh: 你站得很直，像一根还没倒的秆。
lines.en: You stand straight, like a stalk not yet fallen.

lines.zh: 我看你，是看一堆会走的口粮。
lines.en: I see you as walking provisions.

lines.zh: 别紧张，我只先看你的口袋。
lines.en: Do not tense up; I am only checking your pockets.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在兜帽下面发暗绿。
lines.en: My eyes glow dull green beneath my hood.

lines.zh: 你后退一步，我的头就歪一点。
lines.en: You step back once, and my head tilts a little.

lines.zh: 我记得你这种脸，村里的那种。
lines.en: I know that kind of face, the village kind.

lines.zh: 我慢慢抬头，甲片咔咔响。
lines.en: I raise my head slowly, plating clicking.

lines.zh: 你看我时，我也在量你的重量。
lines.en: While you watch me, I am weighing you.

lines.zh: 我的目光停在你的锄头上。
lines.en: My gaze settles on your hoe.

lines.zh: 剑砍进甲缝，腐液溅出来。
lines.en: A sword bites my seam and rot sprays out.

lines.zh: 我疼，但饥饿点还在涨。
lines.en: It hurts, yet my hunger points still climb.

lines.zh: 被打退半步，我又走回来。
lines.en: Knocked back half a step, I walk back.

lines.zh: 你砍掉一片甲，里面全是菌丝。
lines.en: You shear off a plate; mycelium fills the gap.

lines.zh: 我的伤口不平，边沿在长。
lines.en: My wound is ragged, and its edges are growing.

lines.zh: 痛感传得很慢，我先看你。
lines.en: The pain arrives late; I look at you first.

lines.zh: 这一刀让我吐出半口胃液。
lines.en: The cut makes me spit up half a mouth of bile.

lines.zh: 我不叫，只把肩膀压低。
lines.en: I make no sound, only lower my shoulder.

lines.zh: 甲碎了，我照样站着。
lines.en: The plate cracks, and I still stand.

lines.zh: 你伤的是壳，不是饿。
lines.en: You wounded the shell, not the hunger.

lines.zh: 你手里的胡萝卜，比命重要。
lines.en: The carrot in your hand matters more than your life.

lines.zh: 别晃那捆小麦，我会跟上来。
lines.en: Do not wave that wheat bundle; I will follow.

lines.zh: 你把面包举高，我只闻到麦香。
lines.en: You raise the bread; I only smell the wheat.

lines.zh: 我靠近，是因为你脚边有种子。
lines.en: I come closer because there are seeds at your feet.

lines.zh: 我不吃你的手，只吃你手里的。
lines.en: I do not eat your hand, only what it holds.

lines.zh: 你一撒种子，我就低头去捡。
lines.en: Scatter seeds and I bend to gather them.

lines.zh: 你脚边的南瓜，我先咬一口。
lines.en: I take a bite of the pumpkin by your feet first.

lines.zh: 甜菜根的气味让我走得更快。
lines.en: The smell of beetroot makes me walk faster.

lines.zh: 你把干草放下，我就停下。
lines.en: Set the hay down and I will stop.

lines.zh: 我伸手不是为了你，是为了庄稼。
lines.en: I reach out for the crops, not for you.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，像撞一堵湿墙。
lines.en: You hit me like hitting a wet wall.

lines.zh: 八层甲很硬，你的肩会疼。
lines.en: Eight layers of plate are hard; your shoulder will ache.

lines.zh: 我被推得挪了半步，又站定。
lines.en: I shift half a step, then settle again.

lines.zh: 我的臂骨硌人，别贴太近。
lines.en: My arm bones are sharp; do not stand so close.

lines.zh: 碰撞声闷，像拍打一只谷袋。
lines.en: The impact sounds dull, like slapping a grain sack.

lines.zh: 你一碰，我喉咙里咕噜一声。
lines.en: One touch, and my throat gurgles once.

lines.zh: 我太重了，你推不动我。
lines.en: I am too heavy; you cannot push me.

lines.zh: 我的甲缝里渗出黏菌，沾你袖口。
lines.en: Slime seeps from my plate seams onto your sleeve.

lines.zh: 擦身而过时，你闻到腐草味。
lines.en: As we pass, you catch the smell of rotting grass.

lines.zh: 我被撞歪，又慢慢正回来。
lines.en: The bump tilts me, and I slowly straighten.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，各看一片田。
lines.en: We stand side by side, each watching a field.

lines.zh: 两个收割者不需要说话。
lines.en: Two reapers have no need to speak.

lines.zh: 它的饥饿点比我多，我让给它。
lines.en: It has more hunger points; I yield to it.

lines.zh: 我们一起把这块地吃空。
lines.en: Together we strip this plot bare.

lines.zh: 它的甲片我认得，是同一批。
lines.en: I know its plating; we were made in one batch.

lines.zh: 我们隔着田垄对望，谁也不动。
lines.en: We face each other across the furrow, neither moving.

lines.zh: 等它吐完那发，我才往前走。
lines.en: I wait for its spit to land before I advance.

lines.zh: 两个影子在麦地里叠在一起。
lines.en: Two shadows overlap in the wheat.

lines.zh: 我们不争，田够大。
lines.en: We do not quarrel; the field is large enough.

lines.zh: 它的腐味和我的一样。
lines.en: Its rot smells the same as mine.

lines.zh: 地里掉的东西，我直接用嘴。
lines.en: Whatever drops in the field goes straight into my mouth.

lines.zh: 我低头把种子连土一起吞。
lines.en: I bend and swallow seeds together with the soil.

lines.zh: 你丢的锄头，我踩进泥里。
lines.en: Your dropped hoe goes into the mud under my foot.

lines.zh: 我不捡铁，铁不能吃。
lines.en: I do not pick up iron; iron cannot be eaten.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的胡萝卜归我。
lines.en: Carrots on the ground belong to me.

lines.zh: 我弯腰很慢，但一定捡到。
lines.en: I bend slowly, but I always pick it up.

lines.zh: 一块干草落下来，砸在我背上。
lines.en: A hay bale falls and strikes my back.

lines.zh: 我把树苗叼起来，嚼两下。
lines.en: I take a sapling in my mouth and chew twice.

lines.zh: 谁丢的麦子，就是谁的葬礼。
lines.en: Whose wheat falls is whose funeral.

lines.zh: 我收集的不是宝物，是口粮。
lines.en: What I gather is not treasure but rations.

lines.zh: 你踏进这片田，我就看见你了。
lines.en: You step into my field, and I have seen you.

lines.zh: 我选定你，因为你会种地。
lines.en: I choose you because you know how to farm.

lines.zh: 你身上的麦香出卖了你。
lines.en: The wheat smell on you gives you away.

lines.zh: 视线一落，你就跑不掉了。
lines.en: My gaze falls, and you cannot run.

lines.zh: 我开始走近，不快，但不停。
lines.en: I start walking, not fast, but never stopping.

lines.zh: 你踩坏了我的作物，我记住了。
lines.en: You crushed my crops; I remember.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，甲片全都张开。
lines.en: I raise my head and my plates flare open.

lines.zh: 你离得最近，所以是你。
lines.en: You are nearest, so you are the one.

lines.zh: 我把你算进这一季的收成。
lines.en: I count you in this season's harvest.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙开始为下一次呕吐发亮。
lines.en: My throat begins to glow for the next spit.

lines.zh: 我追着你，绕过一整排南瓜。
lines.en: I chase you around a whole row of pumpkins.

lines.zh: 你跑进屋子，我拆门。
lines.en: You run indoors; I take the door apart.

lines.zh: 投射物在喉咙里成型了。
lines.en: A projectile forms in my throat.

lines.zh: 每五秒，我往你脚边吐一口。
lines.en: Every five seconds I spit at your feet.

lines.zh: 腐蚀落在你的靴子上，冒白烟。
lines.en: Corrosion hits your boots and smokes white.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的背影，一步不落。
lines.en: I fix on your back and lose no step.

lines.zh: 你翻栅栏，我从下面撞过去。
lines.en: You vault the fence; I smash through beneath it.

lines.zh: 我追到田边，就慢下来等你。
lines.en: At the field's edge I slow and wait for you.

lines.zh: 我算着距离，够近才挥臂。
lines.en: I measure the distance and swing only when close.

lines.zh: 你绕树三圈，我还在原路。
lines.en: You circle the tree three times; I hold the same path.

lines.zh: 我一臂扫下，十点伤害很实在。
lines.en: My arm comes down, and ten points land hard.

lines.zh: 你被打得撞进麦堆里。
lines.en: The blow throws you into the wheat pile.

lines.zh: 我的拳落在你胸口，甲片响。
lines.en: My fist hits your chest; my plating rings.

lines.zh: 你举盾，我就砸盾沿。
lines.en: You raise a shield; I hammer its rim.

lines.zh: 这一下，是替那块被吃掉的田。
lines.en: This blow is for the field that was eaten.

lines.zh: 我挥臂慢，但落点准。
lines.en: My swing is slow, but it lands true.

lines.zh: 你被拍倒，我低头看你。
lines.en: You are knocked down; I lower my head to look.

lines.zh: 我的指节带着腐液，蹭过你脖颈。
lines.en: My knuckles, slick with rot, graze your neck.

lines.zh: 打得你后退三步，正好退进我的田。
lines.en: Three steps back, and you are inside my field.

lines.zh: 我不喊，只把力气全压在臂上。
lines.en: I make no cry; I put all my strength into the arm.

lines.zh: 我从被链接的村民身上裂开。
lines.en: I split out of a linked villager's body.

lines.zh: 菌丝先缠住我的腿，再裹住脸。
lines.en: Mycelium binds my legs first, then my face.

lines.zh: 我睁眼时，手里还攥着一把麦。
lines.en: I open my eyes still gripping a handful of wheat.

lines.zh: 村庄的钟声在我进化时停了。
lines.en: The village bell stopped while I evolved.

lines.zh: 我从腐土里站起，身上挂着甲片。
lines.en: I rise from rotten soil wearing plates.

lines.zh: 第一件事，是找一块能吃的田。
lines.en: My first act is to find a field to eat.

lines.zh: 我听见自己的喉咙在数五秒。
lines.en: I hear my own throat counting five seconds.

lines.zh: 收割者的名字，是别人给的。
lines.en: The name Reaper was given by others.

lines.zh: 我出生时，田野已经荒了。
lines.en: The fields were already barren when I was born.

lines.zh: 甲片一片片扣上，像农具入鞘。
lines.en: Plate by plate I close, like tools into a sheath.

lines.zh: 我记不起自己的名字，只记得饿。
lines.en: I forget my name, but not my hunger.

lines.zh: 腐液从我喉头滴到第一株麦上。
lines.en: Rot drips from my throat onto the first wheat.

lines.zh: 火燎过甲片，里面的菌在缩。
lines.en: Fire licks my plates and the fungus inside shrinks.

lines.zh: 我从高处砸下，甲片陷进土里。
lines.en: I drop from height and my plates sink into soil.

lines.zh: 水灌进甲缝，饥饿点全凉了。
lines.en: Water floods my seams and every hunger point goes cold.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀开我半边甲，露出菌丝。
lines.en: A blast tears half my plating off, baring mycelium.

lines.zh: 箭卡在甲缝，我不去拔。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my seam; I do not pull it.

lines.zh: 药水浇上来，菌丝缩成一团。
lines.en: A potion splashes on me and my mycelium curls tight.

lines.zh: 田被烧光时，我才知道什么叫饿。
lines.en: When the fields burned, I learned what hunger means.

lines.zh: 雷打在我甲上，整片田都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my plating and the whole field lights up.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有田，我张着嘴下坠。
lines.en: There is no field in the void; I fall with my mouth open.
